body: Orchestrator adversarial review of PR #312 (diff head 3cbcf388 on main 8d719629; final head fd4ff82d is the gh pr update-branch merge of main ad8ed474, which adds only .orchestration files). Re-derived from the diff: scripts/lib/github-release.sh resolves the newest non-draft, non-prerelease GitHub release at least 72h old (constant named once, pointing at minimum_release_age), fetches the list whole before awk parses it, authenticates through GITHUB_TOKEN/GH_TOKEN or gh's github.com token passed via curl -K - on stdin or a 0600 wgetrc, gates attestation checks on gh >= 2.93.0 (GHSA-8xvp-7hj6-mcj9) authenticated to github.com, and verifies with gh release verify-asset --repo github.com/<repo>. mise and chezmoi (setup.sh carries a copy kept equal by test_github_release.py) keep their checksum-file checks and add the attestation when gh is ready; starship uses the .sha256 sidecar; crit uses checksums.txt; zed requires the release attestation and installs nothing without an authenticated gh (exit 0 with the make gh-auth hint, a failed attestation exits non-zero); sheldon builds the newest crate with cargo --locked; the AWS CLI takes the unversioned archive with GPG and the pinned fingerprint and reinstalls on an ETag change or a broken binary. The wrappers for zed, starship, sheldon and the AWS CLI are run_after (every apply) with idempotent skips and offline tolerance; the mise bootstrap stays run_once (self-update moves it). Manifest: release: latest without pin/sha256/reason, pinned assets with a reason; the validator enforces both and the attestation field; render constants and installer-pins.sh remain only for the pinned assets; the dead T118 pin block in upgrade-tools.sh is deleted; workflows run mise-action without a version; make docker resolves the chezmoi tag with the helper. Evidence: helper live output (v2026.10.3 chosen with v2026.10.6/10.5/10.4 skipped, chezmoi v2.73.0), a scratch-HOME mise bootstrap end to end, each every-apply installer run twice with the second skipping, CI bootstrap logs showing gh release verify-asset success for chezmoi v2.73.0, mise v2026.10.3 and zed v1.22.0. Seven Bot threads (three P2 on f688336c, two P1 and two P2 on 7903de38) fixed at their root cause in 89d9b982 and 3cbcf388, each verified in the diff, replied to and resolved by the orchestrator. Ten scope questions answered by Amendments 1-6; every default matched the task's principle. CI 16 of 16 on 3cbcf388; Codex Bot completed with no findings on 3cbcf388. Verdict: send the final head to the task-level audit once CI and the Bot complete on it.

Orchestrator adversarial review of PR #312 round-2 head 0d264db8 (one commit on the update-branch head fd4ff82d). Re-derived from the diff: github_release_list saves the xtrace flag from $-, turns it off before the credential is read or the header is built (the request body moved to github_release_fetch), restores it on every path and returns the fetch status; the setup.sh copy carries the same 18 lines. install_aws_cli removes v2/<staged version> only after gpgv and the staged CLI passed and only when the installed CLI no longer runs, so the upstream --update cannot skip a corrupt same-version tree while a working install is never touched; the version is matched against ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)*$ before any rm. Tests: the xtrace test covers curl+GITHUB_TOKEN, wget+GH_TOKEN and the gh auth token fallback, asserting the token is absent from stderr, the header reached the fake and xtrace is restored; the AWS test uses a fake upstream installer mimicking the same-version skip; validation 12 shows both failing against fd4ff82d (three xtrace subcases with the token in the trace; the AWS case exiting 42 after 'Skipping install'). CI 16 of 16 on 0d264db8; Codex Bot completed with no findings; 0 unresolved threads after the orchestrator verified, replied to and resolved the two; sweep 33 items all dispositioned at 0d264db8; main unchanged at ad8ed474, so no further update-branch. Verdict: send to the task-level audit.

Orchestrator adversarial review of PR #312 round-3 head 674aaac0 (2453b1c9, aa69c2a0, f3c155ee, 674aaac0 on 0d264db8). Re-derived from the diff: github_release_tag returns only tags matching GITHUB_RELEASE_TAG_PATTERN (anchored version shape) and fails with 'unexpected release tag' otherwise, and make docker resolves the tag inside its recipe shell, so fetched text never becomes Make or shell source (the auditor's crafted tag is refused, 13d); the four version probes capture output and status and print nothing when --version exits non-zero; the mise bootstrap, when gpg and gpgv exist, takes the checksums from SHASUMS256.asc verified by gpgv against the release key with the fingerprint pinned in assets.mise (key fetched from keys.openpgp.org, validity and expiry checked, fail closed), and otherwise falls back to SHASUMS256.txt naming the weaker mechanism; when gh cannot verify the attestation, github_release_defer_attestation keeps the archive and a record under state/dotfiles/pending-attestation/<tool>, and a new required phase in upgrade-tools.sh before mise self-update verifies pending records once gh >= 2.93 is authenticated (success removes the record, failure stops make update naming the tool and archive, gh not ready warns once); Amendment 7: crit and starship return to reviewed pins with per-platform sha256 and reasons, the same-release checksum kept as a second check (replay 13h: a replaced release whose checksums.txt matches is refused); minimum_release_age: 72h on all four mise-action steps; zed keeps an installed release at or past the cooled-down one (sort -V) and keeps the installed Zed on a failed download (exit 3) ; attestation checks prefer mise's gh shim through a function-local PATH; the AWS postcondition requires the staged version to be active and the same-version directory is removed whenever the active CLI differs. CompactionDB evidence pasted in 13m (ids 997c53f5, f2e33997, 68c0a3fe). CI 17 of 17 (GitGuardian first reported on this head); Codex Bot completed with no findings on 674aaac0; seven Bot threads on the interim heads verified in the diff, replied to and resolved by the orchestrator; sweep 47 items dispositioned at 674aaac0; main unchanged at ad8ed474. Residual, reported as a scope gap by the worker: the mise release key is fetched from a keyserver at bootstrap (fingerprint pinned); committing the key would remove that availability dependency and is queued for T123. Verdict: send to the task-level audit.

Orchestrator adversarial review of PR #312 round-4 head 73034ae4 (19504fe5, 16a64632, e0fed47e, 8cb8a1d1, 73034ae4 on 674aaac0). Re-derived from the diff: the CI chezmoi step verifies the archive with github_release_attestation (fail closed) after the checksum, and all four test jobs show 'Verification succeeded' for chezmoi v2.73.0 (14a); make docker verifies on the host through the new github_release_verified_sha256 (gh ready required first with the make gh-auth hint, checksum then verify-asset, no deferral), passes CHEZMOI_VERSION and CHEZMOI_SHA256, and the Dockerfile checks its download against that sha256 only; an existing image is reused only with a matching version label and a 64-character chezmoi.sha256 label, so images from the old recipe are rebuilt; starship, aws-cli and sheldon return 3 on a download failure and main keeps a working install with one warning while verification failures and no-install cases still fail (sheldon classifies cargo's log; a checksum message always fails); the validator refuses release: latest with a same-release-only verify unless an attestation is declared; the wgetrc lives in a trapped subshell; only a stable gh X.Y.Z >= 2.93.0 is used for attestations. Tests for each fail before their fix inside the sandbox (14b, 14e); the full suite in the sandbox shows no failure outside the branch-base baseline, plain and with the TMPDIR mktemp shim (14f). Conformance: the sandbox record is rewritten from the transcript and states that 127 commands ran outside the sandbox in rounds 0-3, of which unit tests, replays, curl downloads, shellcheck, memory searches, bundled local edits, two artifact copies with the worker's own masking, and one downloaded crit binary executed outside the sandbox are outside Worker Playbook step 4, with five of eight refusals reworked; round 4 lists 26 outside commands, all within step 4 except one bundled scratch edit it names, no refusal, nothing reworked, and the repository masker used; every command verbatim in 14g. CI 17 of 17; Codex Bot completed with no findings on 73034ae4; four Bot threads on interim heads verified in the diff, replied to and resolved by the orchestrator; sweep 67 items dispositioned; main unchanged at ad8ed474. Verdict: send to the task-level audit; the conformance deviation stays recorded against the task.

Orchestrator adversarial review of PR #312 round-5 head 36d87f6c (96253ea3, 70361875, 50759078, 36d87f6c on 73034ae4). Re-derived from the diff: github_release_attestation sends gh's verification report to stderr, so github_release_verified_sha256 prints only the digest (the make docker build arg is one 64-character line); an offline AWS lookup keeps only a working CLI; Amendment 8 replaces the deferral: setup.sh and install/common/mise.sh install the newest cooled-down release only when the attestation (gh) or, for mise, the release key's signature (gpg) can verify it before it runs, and otherwise the reviewed fallback release pinned in assets.<name>.fallback with per-platform sha256 and a reason, rendered into both scripts, the release checksum file kept as a second check; github_release_defer_attestation, the pending-attestation records and the upgrade-tools phase are deleted with their tests; the validator requires fallback.pin/sha256/reason for a rolling asset with an attestation and forbids fallback elsewhere; Enterprise GITHUB_TOKEN/GH_TOKEN never reach github.com (github_enterprise_context, github_dotcom_gh); a mise advanced by self-update is kept on the fallback path (version compared); an unreachable key or SHASUMS256.asc falls back to the attestation with gh ready and fails without it, a bad signature always fails. Evidence: 15b live in the sandbox (no gh, no gpg installs the fallback; a rerun keeps it and fetches nothing; a replaced release and a tampered chezmoi archive are refused by the reviewed sha256), 15d CI verifying chezmoi and mise before they run on the gh-ready path, 15e tests failing against 50759078, 15h full suite in the sandbox with no failure outside the baseline, 15g the corrected mutation inventory with sources. Round 5 ran outside the sandbox only step 4's cases, no refusal, nothing reworked. CI 17 of 17; Codex Bot completed with no findings on 36d87f6c; five Bot threads on interim heads verified in the diff, replied to and resolved by the orchestrator; sweep 83 items dispositioned; main unchanged at ad8ed474. Verdict: send to the task-level audit.
